facts.fact: 婚礼日黄裙（moth-eaten muslin）：Veronica 揭底「你穿的是 Hope 的裙子」——Rue 摸脖子找不存在的绳套；「Fuck.」
Hope 死因档案补完：被控偷银器、母亲被叮嘱「take her time」、半绑无眼半喉逃亡未遂——「No one escapes Folkehaven Manor or my mother.」
facts.anchor: she fled half-bound with no eyes and half a throat.

facts.fact: Veronica 粉裙（花被压皱）陪行：仆役逻辑「我们存在于社会之中——不在其上」；「母亲与镇民互为奴役——若她没用了他们会怎样？」「I would pay dearly to watch this town eat itself.」
婚礼：野花装饰（如 Anne）；Ladies/Lords 缺席（娘家不赞成）；Oren 握手 Edward「善待她」——Edward 若负 Anne 血债在 Oren 或母亲之手，但他不缩「the most guiltless of us all」
教堂后排调情（unmarried relations→smelling salts）后三连：「I need you, Oren.」——妹妹走向圣坛之前他说「And I am here, Rue.」
Anne 的极简幸福（海边小屋、小花园「It is a simple life, Rue, and it is all I want.」）——拥抱成功：「My arms fold around her body without thinking, my muscles remembering」——肌肉记得了
facts.anchor: My arms fold around her body without thinking

facts.fact: 墓碑边界谈判：「I will not marry.」「I will not leave my mother for you.」——Oren 两次回应「I did not ask you (to).」；「You talk of yourself in pieces…Fragments of a person」「Who do you want to be?」「A daughter, beloved, wanted」

「If love is a ruination, then may God damn me.」「They are in earnest.」「Allow me to love you…All of the pieces of you, the wholeness of you.」「I love you.」——她吞下那些词「like viscera, and it fills me」；hallowed ground 上 only God to witness；结尾睡在他的心跳声里，醒来已是夜
